name: Kinomoto Asuka
source:
Classmate. Belongs to the (Boob) Track and Field Club. The club's ace. An all-around athlete, she's in high demand as a substitute for other clubs.

She's an energetic girl who gets along well with others (especially close with Yumari) and shows her girly side to those around her.

For some reason, she rebels against the protagonist, always taking an aggressive stance, but as they spend time together, a change begins to show...?

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=827979&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
